results.title: A Venezuelan doctor picnicking in Georgia rushed to revive a 1-year-old boy who stopped breathing in a pool; Maddox is now 2, shares her birthday, and she has been honoured for saving his life
results.description: Dr. Andrea Sansonnet saved one-year-old Maddox from drowning at a swimming pool in Newnan, Georgia. Her quick actions included performing CPR until he was breathing again after being underwater for about 90 seconds. On their shared birthday, the Newnan Police Department honored Dr. Sansonnet for her lifesaving efforts during the emergency. Maddox’s mother expressed gratitude for the doctor’s presence when the incident occurred.
